retained_failures.note: Git reported a transient DNS failure resolving github.com; read-only DNS and ls-remote checks then passed, and the exact unchanged commit pushed successfully.
Unquoted ^{} revision syntax was mangled by PowerShell after local tag creation; the tag remained local and a shell-safe rev-list check proved its exact target before push.
The tag push succeeded, but the combined post-push command again exposed unquoted PowerShell peel syntax; a quoted remote ref pattern then verified both tag object and peeled commit.
